question: What is purity according to the guru for one who does not abandon self-light?
premises: Purity is seeing capacity of the different from non-difference in self.
It belongs to one who does not abandon self-light.
inference: Purity is the capacity to see difference without losing non-difference in self-light.
plain_english: Purity, as the guru taught, is the seeing capacity of the different arising from non-difference in self, for one who does not abandon self-light.
